worlds.name: Medieval Highlands World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to enter this Novice Difficulty (0) Adventure World, where once stood great kingdoms, but now only the bugs and fungi thrive among the ruins

worlds.name: Permafrost World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to venture to this Adept Difficulty (1) Adventure World, once home to a great empire, now a frozen wasteland where predators and phantoms prowl.

worlds.name: Cursed Vale World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to journey to this Elite Difficulty (2) Adventure World, where an accursed darkness tears the rotting dead from their graves to prey upon the living.

worlds.name: Desert Frontier World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to travel to this Master Difficulty (3) Adventure World, the desolate husk of a land plundered by unchecked greed, progress, and the mindless slaves of industry.

worlds.name: Fae Forest World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to enter this Uber Difficulty (4) Adventure World, where the races of Fae have turned their backs on the outside world to focus on a bloody civil war.\n\nComplete dungeons in this world for Delve Shadowkey Fragments.

worlds.name: Candorian World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to voyage into this Shade Difficulty (5) Adventure World, where clashing confectionery civilizations vie for power and influence.\n\nComplete dungeons in this world for Delve Shadowkey Fragments.

worlds.name: Neon City World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to beam into this Fallow Difficulty (6) Adventure World, where a technological singularity wrought the rise of the ruthless Robot Overlords to power.\n\nComplete dungeons in this world for Delve Shadowkey Fragments.

worlds.name: Jurassic Jungle World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to travel to this Twilight Difficulty (7) Adventure World, a land unchanged for aeons until the arrival of a mysterious meteorite.\n\nComplete dungeons in this world for Delve Shadowkey Fragments.

worlds.name: Dragonfire Peaks World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to brave this Dusk Difficulty (8) Adventure World, a land of fire and Dragons thrown into turmoil by a false prophet.\n\nComplete dungeons in this world for Delve Shadowkey Fragments.

worlds.name: Forbidden Spires World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to enter this Nightfall Difficulty (9) Adventure World, where a once mighty empire now lies silent, and yet their edifices remain in all their splendor.\n\nComplete dungeons in this world for Delve Shadowkey Fragments.

worlds.name: Sundered Uplands World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to enter this Moonless Dark Difficulty (10) Adventure World, a land split in two by invading Irradiant Sky Giants. Warning! At all difficulty ranks, creatures in the Sundered Uplands biomes are significantly more difficult than neighboring biomes!\n\nComplete dungeons in this world for Delve Shadowkey Fragments.

worlds.name: Mysterious Lunar Portal
worlds.description: This cursed portal is clearly the work of the Moon Goddess. Proceed with caution!

worlds.name: Prime World
worlds.description: Press [HK:Loot] to enter this Adventure World, an amalgam of many lands coalesced in the aftermath of the Sundering.\n\nComplete dungeons in this world for Delve Shadowkey Fragments.
